PRODUCTION SETUP CHECKLIST

1. Replace YOUR_CALENDAR_ID, YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID and YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.
2. Reconnect Google Calendar, Google Sheets, Gmail and Telegram credentials after import.
3. Create a Bookings sheet with the mapped columns.
4. Test with a staging calendar/account before production.
5. Add a separate n8n Error Workflow using Error Trigger to alert staff on failures.
6. Add cancellation/reschedule webhooks if your form supports them.
7. Set the workflow timezone to your actual business timezone.
8. Avoid storing sensitive data unnecessarily.
